title: On minimally 1-tough $(K_1\cup P_4)$-free graphs
summary: Agraph G is minimally t-tough if the toughness of G is t and the deletion of any edge from G decreases its toughness, where t is a positive real number. It is conjectured that every $(K_1\cup P_4)$-free 1-tough graph is hamiltonian. In this paper, we characterize the structure of minimally 1-tough $(K_1\cup P_4)$-free graphs, and thus show that the above conjecture is true for minimally 1-tough graphs. Furthermore, it is also proved that the Kriesell's conjecture which states that each minimally 1-tough graph has a vertex of degree 2 holds for minimally 1-tough $(K_1\cup P_4)$-free graphs.
